Your name has been entered onto the senior muster-roll; draw better steel from the armory.
You held the line when hired blades broke—wear this rank-badge where the pickets can see it.
The council weighed your deeds on honest scales and found no shortfall. Step up in standing.
From this watch forward, sentries will salute your passage without demanding a toll-chit.
Few survive long enough in Thornvael to earn a second stripe; fewer still deserve it as cleanly.
The elders have witnessed your oath in iron and tallow. New vaults and quarters are now yours.
Word of your stand reached the citadel before the ash cooled—accept the rank you paid for in blood.
No more standing at the outer gate with drifters; take your seat at the war-table.
Your ledger stands clear of debt and rich in service. Wear the seal of our inner circle.
The veterans voted at dawn without a single dissenting voice: you lead the vanguard now.
